The option types are renamed. TypeScript shows an error for each old name:

| 2.0.0-beta.1                   | 2.0.0-beta.2                    |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `MediaPreviewPluginConfig`     | `MediaPreviewPluginOptions`     |
| `MediaPreviewCollectionConfig` | `MediaPreviewCollectionOptions` |
| `MediaPreviewFieldConfig`      | `MediaPreviewFieldOptions`      |

```bash
pnpm add @seshuk/payload-plugin-media-preview@beta
```
